sources.title: aiden-li/so101-act · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for act Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an imitation-learning method that predicts short action chunks instead of single steps. It learns from teleoperated data and often achieves high success rates. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.

sources.title: Gemini Updates by Google - August 2026 - Releasebot
sources.snippet: Gemini introduces Gemini Omni Flash, a new video model that makes creating and editing videos feel like a conversation. It can generate clips from text, image, video, or audio references, edit scenes, and is now available in the Gemini app, Google Flow, Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.

sources.title: DreamZero-SO101 — An Open World Model for the SO-101 Robot Arm
sources.snippet: DreamZero-SO101 is an open-source world-action model for the SO-101 robot arm. Given a single camera frame and a language instruction, it imagines the robot completing the task.
